title: Denial Prevention Simulator
subtitle: Northbridge Medical Group (fictional) · 11,967 claims · 14.0% denied, $5,419,266 denied. 76.6% of denials trace to a control that could have been checked before submission. This page sizes that opportunity and ranks the work queue that would capture it.
limitations: Preventable is defined by a mapping from denial reason to an upstream control, which credits prevention to a control that might have failed anyway. The prevention opportunity is a modelled figure at 100% control effectiveness and is not a savings forecast; real capture depends on staffing and payer behaviour. Risk score weights are judgement, not a fitted model, so the score ranks claims and does not estimate probability. The data is fully synthetic.
footer: Source: synthetic data generated by src/generate_data.py. No employer data, patient information, protected health information or confidential business information is used.

queries.headline: SELECT COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(SUM(Claim_Amount),0) AS billed, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN Denial_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS denial_pct, ROUND(SUM(Denied_Amount),0) AS denied_amt, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN Denial_Flag='Yes' AND Preventable_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Denial_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),1) AS preventable_pct, ROUND(SUM(Prevention_Opportunity),0) AS opportunity, ROUND(SUM(Recovery_Amount),0) AS recovered, ROUND(100.0*11967/12014,2) AS dq_score FROM claims_fact
queries.queue_head: SELECT COUNT(*) AS queued, ROUND(SUM(At_Risk_Amount),0) AS at_risk, SUM(CASE WHEN Risk_Band IN ('High','Critical') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk FROM pre_submission_queue
queries.by_reason: SELECT r.Reason_Description, r.Reason_Category, r.Preventable, COUNT(*) AS denials, ROUND(SUM(c.Denied_Amount),0) AS denied_amt, ROUND(SUM(c.Prevention_Opportunity),0) AS opportunity FROM claims_fact c JOIN dim_denial_reason r ON r.Denial_Reason_Code=c.Denial_Reason_Code WHERE c.Denial_Flag='Yes' GROUP BY r.Reason_Description, r.Reason_Category, r.Preventable ORDER BY denied_amt DESC
queries.by_category: SELECT r.Reason_Category, ROUND(SUM(c.Denied_Amount),0) AS denied_amt, COUNT(*) AS denials FROM claims_fact c JOIN dim_denial_reason r ON r.Denial_Reason_Code=c.Denial_Reason_Code WHERE c.Denial_Flag='Yes' GROUP BY r.Reason_Category ORDER BY denied_amt DESC
queries.by_payer: SELECT p.Payer_Name, p.Payer_Type, COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN c.Denial_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS denial_pct, ROUND(SUM(c.Denied_Amount),0) AS denied_amt, ROUND(AVG(c.Days_Outstanding),1) AS days_outstanding FROM claims_fact c JOIN dim_payer p ON p.Payer_ID=c.Payer_ID GROUP BY p.Payer_Name, p.Payer_Type ORDER BY denial_pct DESC
queries.by_service: SELECT Service_Line, COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN Denial_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS denial_pct, ROUND(SUM(Denied_Amount),0) AS denied_amt, ROUND(SUM(Prevention_Opportunity),0) AS opportunity FROM claims_fact GROUP BY Service_Line ORDER BY denial_pct DESC
queries.controls: SELECT 'Authorization missing where required' AS control, SUM(CASE WHEN Auth_Required='Yes' AND Authorization_Present='No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gaps, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN Auth_Required='Yes' AND Authorization_Present='No' AND Denial_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Auth_Required='Yes' AND Authorization_Present='No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),1) AS denial_pct_when_failed FROM claims_fact UNION ALL SELECT 'Eligibility not verified', SUM(CASE WHEN Eligibility_Verified='No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN Eligibility_Verified='No' AND Denial_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Eligibility_Verified='No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),1) FROM claims_fact UNION ALL SELECT 'Documentation incomplete', SUM(CASE WHEN Documentation_Complete='No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN Documentation_Complete='No' AND Denial_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Documentation_Complete='No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),1) FROM claims_fact UNION ALL SELECT 'Coding validation failed', SUM(CASE WHEN Coding_Validation_Passed='No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN Coding_Validation_Passed='No' AND Denial_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Coding_Validation_Passed='No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),1) FROM claims_fact UNION ALL SELECT 'Timely filing at risk', SUM(CASE WHEN Timely_Filing_Risk='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN Timely_Filing_Risk='Yes' AND Denial_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Timely_Filing_Risk='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),1) FROM claims_fact
queries.risk_band: SELECT Risk_Band, COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN Denial_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS denial_pct, ROUND(SUM(Denied_Amount),0) AS denied_amt FROM claims_fact GROUP BY Risk_Band ORDER BY AVG(Preventable_Risk_Score)
queries.submit_lag: SELECT CASE WHEN Days_To_Submit<=3 THEN '0-3 days' WHEN Days_To_Submit<=7 THEN '4-7 days' WHEN Days_To_Submit<=14 THEN '8-14 days' WHEN Days_To_Submit<=30 THEN '15-30 days' ELSE '31+ days' END AS band, COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN Denial_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS denial_pct FROM claims_fact GROUP BY band ORDER BY MIN(Days_To_Submit)
queries.monthly: SELECT substr(Service_Date,1,7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN Denial_Flag='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS denial_pct, ROUND(SUM(Denied_Amount),0) AS denied_amt FROM claims_fact GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
queries.resub: SELECT CASE WHEN Resubmission_Flag='Yes' THEN 'Resubmitted' ELSE 'Not resubmitted' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS denials, ROUND(SUM(Denied_Amount),0) AS denied_amt, ROUND(SUM(Recovery_Amount),0) AS recovered, ROUND(100.0*SUM(Recovery_Amount)/NULLIF(SUM(Denied_Amount),0),1) AS recovery_pct FROM claims_fact WHERE Denial_Flag='Yes' GROUP BY bucket
queries.work_queue: SELECT Work_Queue, COUNT(*) AS denials, ROUND(SUM(Denied_Amount),0) AS denied_amt, ROUND(AVG(Days_Outstanding),1) AS days_outstanding, ROUND(AVG(Recovery_Priority_Score),1) AS priority_score FROM claims_fact WHERE Denial_Flag='Yes' GROUP BY Work_Queue ORDER BY denied_amt DESC
queries.rules: SELECT Rule_ID, Trigger, Prevention_Action, Owner, Linked_Denial_Reason FROM prevention_rules ORDER BY Rule_ID
queries.queue: SELECT Claim_ID, Payer_ID, Service_Line, ROUND(Claim_Amount,0) AS Claim_Amount, Risk_Band, ROUND(Preventable_Risk_Score,1) AS score, Triggered_Rules, Primary_Owner FROM pre_submission_queue ORDER BY Preventable_Risk_Score DESC, Claim_Amount DESC LIMIT 25
queries.queue_owner: SELECT Primary_Owner, COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(SUM(At_Risk_Amount),0) AS at_risk FROM pre_submission_queue GROUP BY Primary_Owner ORDER BY at_risk DESC
queries.exceptions: SELECT Rule_ID, Severity, Status, COUNT(*) AS exceptions FROM dq_exceptions GROUP BY Rule_ID, Severity, Status ORDER BY exceptions DESC

kpis.label: Modelled prevention opportunity
kpis.note: At 100% control effectiveness — not a forecast

cards.title: Denied dollars by reason
cards.desc: Sorted by money, not by count, because the two orderings disagree. The Preventable column is the mapping the whole model rests on and is shown explicitly rather than hidden in a filter.

cards.title: Denied dollars by category
cards.desc: Four categories, one of which is most of the money.

cards.title: Which control failed, and what happened when it did
cards.desc: Bars count claims where the control failed; the line is the denial rate among those claims. A control with few failures but a high denial rate is a cheap fix with real yield.

cards.title: Denial rate by payer
cards.desc: Payer type is shown because the spread tracks it more closely than it tracks volume. Days outstanding is the collections cost of the same denials.

cards.title: Denial rate by service line
cards.desc: Worst first. The lines with the highest rate are not the ones with the most denied dollars, which is why both are plotted.

cards.title: Does the risk score separate anything?
cards.desc: Denial rate rises steeply across the three bands, from single digits in Low to the high thirties in High. The score is a ranking tool built from judgement weights, so this is a sanity check on ordering — not evidence that the score is calibrated to probability.

cards.title: Submission lag and denial rate
cards.desc: Claims submitted late are denied more often, and timely-filing denials are unappealable in a way that documentation denials are not.

cards.title: Monthly trend
cards.desc: Bars are claim volume on the right axis; the line is denial rate. Volume and rate move independently here, so the rate is not a capacity artefact.

cards.title: Recovery on resubmission
cards.desc: Resubmission recovers a real share of denied dollars, which is the argument against treating prevention as the only lever — but it recovers cents on the dollar and costs a second touch.

cards.title: Denial work queues
cards.desc: Where denials currently sit, ranked by dollars. Priority score is the ranking used to sequence work inside each queue.

cards.title: Pre-submission queue by owner
cards.desc: The intervention is only real if someone owns it. Dollars at risk are assigned to the team that can actually clear the trigger.

cards.title: The prevention rules
cards.desc: Five rules, each with the trigger that fires it, the action taken and the owner. Every rule links back to the denial reason it is meant to prevent, so the rule set can be audited against outcomes later.

cards.title: Pre-submission work queue — highest risk first
cards.desc: Unsubmitted claims ranked by risk score then dollar value, with the rules each one triggered. This is the operational output of the whole project: a list someone can work on Monday.

cards.title: Data quality exception log
cards.desc: Every rule violation with severity and disposition. Critical failures are excluded from reporting and logged rather than corrected, because a claim amount cannot be guessed without changing the number being measured.
